_: THE TRANSPARENCY SHELF. The documents Swechha has published about itself, and the registration facts that are on them. Read by scripts/build-about-page.mjs into the `ledger` band on /about. This file is the ONLY place these values are written; the band derives every row from it, so a document added here appears on the page with nothing hand-edited.
_why: The build script's own AD-27.41 note scoped this pass and said what it was for: 'A transparency shelf with twelve real files is worth more than a dotted line saying there is not one, and it is its own pass. DO NOT restore the dotted rows instead of building it.' Nine files sat under public/docs/ answering HTTP 200 and linked from no page on this site, while the footer asserted 80G, 12A and FCRA on all 147 pages with no document behind any of them. That is the one asymmetry this site cannot afford: every environmental reading it publishes names its source, and its own claims named none.
_titles: EVERY ONE OF THESE IS AN *ACTIVITY* REPORT AND THE ROWS SAY SO. Checked by extracting the text of all eight PDFs: each is titled ACTIVITY REPORT or ANNUAL ACTIVITY REPORT, and not one contains an income figure, an expenditure figure, a balance sheet or an auditor's statement. Calling them 'annual reports' on the page would let a reader infer accounts that are not in them. The filenames say annual-report for six of them and are left alone — a filename is a URL and renaming it breaks a link — but the rendered label is the document's own title.
_80g: ★ THERE ARE TWO ORDERS AND ONLY ONE OF THEM IS IN FORCE. India rescinded the old regime: the Income-tax (6th Amendment) Rules, 2021 required every existing 12A and 80G holder to re-register under section 12AB, the new approval issued in Form 10AC with its own URN and a fixed validity. Swechha did that — 12A on 24 September 2021, 80G on 10 March 2022 — and both orders are read from the PDFs themselves and transcribed above. The 2013 order is kept under `eightyg_2013` as history. ★ AND BOTH OF THE NEW ONES RUN OUT AT ASSESSMENT YEAR 2026-27, which covers financial year 2025-26. A donation made in the current financial year falls in assessment year 2027-28 and is OUTSIDE the range on both orders. The renewals are in `holes` below, and the page says so rather than letting a granted-and-expired order stand in for a live one. That is the same rule this file applied to the 2013 order when it was the only one here.
_pan: PUBLISHED BECAUSE THE CERTIFICATE ITSELF REQUIRES IT TO BE. Condition (ii) of the order: 'Every receipt issued to donor shall bear the number and date of this order.' The order number is therefore a thing Swechha is obliged to hand every donor, not a secret. PAN is printed on the same order and on every 80G receipt an Indian donor files with their return. The address on the certificate (a 2013 Shalimar Bagh address) is NOT transcribed: AD-27.8 deliberately dropped the street from the footer and data/org-jsonld.json records why, so reinstating a stale one here would be a struck fact re-imported through a side door.

eightyg_2013._: SUPERSEDED, AND KEPT BECAUSE A SUPERSEDED ORDER IS A FACT ABOUT THE RECORD AND NOT AN EMBARRASSMENT. This is the grant as it was made in 2013, under the regime the Income-tax (6th Amendment) Rules, 2021 replaced. The order above is the one in force. It is not rendered on the page; it is here so that the 2013 number, which older receipts carry, can still be tied to this organisation.

fcra._: THE CERTIFICATE NAMES THE ACCOUNT, WHICH IS WHY BOTH ARE HERE AND WHY /act MAY PRINT IT. Section 17 of the FCRA and clause 2 of this renewal both say a foreign contribution may be received ONLY in this account and that no other amount may be credited to it. The account number on /act and the one on this certificate are the same digits, and a gate on the act build checks that they still are.

_gaps: FOUR YEARS HAVE NO REPORT ON THIS SHELF: 2015–16, 2017–18, 2019–20 and 2021–22. The shelf shows the years it has and does not count the ones it does not — the page renders the rows in this file and nothing else. AD-28 struck the empty-state confession from this site, and a gap counter under a list of nine real documents is exactly that. The gaps live here, in the register, which is where this repository keeps what it knows it is missing.

holes.what: The renewed 12AB registration and 80G approval, for assessment year 2027-28 onwards.
holes.why: Both orders on this shelf were granted for assessment years 2022-23 to 2026-27. That range ends with financial year 2025-26. A gift made today falls outside it, so this site does not tell a donor their gift is deductible — it publishes the orders it holds and their dates, and lets the donor and their accountant read them.
holes.unlocks: The Form 10AD orders granting the renewals, or the Form 10AB acknowledgements if they are still pending.

holes.what: Audited accounts, or any income and expenditure figure, for any year.
holes.why: Not one of the nine reports contains one — they are activity reports. An organisation asking for ₹500 a month publishes no financial figure of any kind.
holes.unlocks: The audited balance sheet for the most recent year, or a single total-income figure with the year it covers.
